entities.name: Joven
entities.description: A human master thief and cat burglar on Ulgrotha, feared by merchants and respected by rogues.

entities.name: Homelands
entities.description: Region of Ulgrotha where Joven had a great reputation.

entities.name: Eron the Relentless
entities.description: Man tricked out of his Ebony Rhino; swore to kill Joven if caught on his side of Strongrock.

entities.name: Ebony Rhino
entities.description: Eron's prized possession, taken by Joven and Chandler.

entities.name: Strongrock
entities.description: Place whose far side Eron claims.

events.summary: Joven and Chandler trick Eron the Relentless into giving them his prized Ebony Rhino.
events.quote: Joven and his partner in crime Chandler tricked Eron the Relentless into giving them his prized Ebony Rhino

events.summary: Eron swears Joven's death will be legendary if caught on his side of Strongrock; Joven still sneaks into Koskun Keep.
events.quote: his death would be more legendary than his deeds

relations.quote: Joven and his partner in crime Chandler

relations.note: Had several disagreements and swore to kill him.
relations.quote: Eron and Joven had several disagreements in the past
